comments.author: Orphos
comments.body: Know someone how to finish this quest? "I should examine the small island near the market" it say.....i searched everywhere but still cannot find right place.

comments.author: Me
comments.body: Put the Observe skill in a Quick-slot and then stand by the market and spam it while you keep looking around with the A or D key for the indicator flash that tells you where to use Search.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: Do not forget that the Observe skill, when used, shows a yellow star on your map that reveals the precise location of the discovery. This star will appear on both the surveying map, and the city map.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Oh, the yellow star definitely shows up on the city map with Observe skill and items that have its effect, it's just not always easy to see. Your proximity to the discovery may also affect whether or not the star appears right away, kind of like with the surveying map in outskirt/landing areas; I can't recall offhand. Thanks for being specific about the NPC's location!
